reproduction: Enroll equipment, tap Write NFC tag, and hold a writable NDEF tag near the iPhone.
observed: Core NFC reports a successful write, but the immediate read-back is stale or loses the tag connection and Trakr shows 'The NFC write could not be verified.' NFC Tools subsequently reads the new payload.
expected: A successful Core NFC write completion proceeds with enrollment. Read-back is best-effort and may improve the confirmation message, but cannot turn a confirmed write into a failure.
